file_impact.reason: The reproduce-to-admit admission runner, its disposition logic, the drift-report writer and the budget pre-flight. Flat sibling of fixture_selection.py/fixture_emit.py (the evals/ package has no fixture_mining/ subpackage; a split would create <100-LOC files banned by module policy).
The admitted per-criterion fixture specs this run writes, for criteria that have no existing packaged spec.
The committed record of candidates that failed to reproduce, with historical and observed behavior.
This epic's own append-only budget ledger, separate from the plan-replay ledger.
Unit tests for the admit/withhold boundary under a stubbed solver, the budget refusal, strict spec validity and the no-shadowing invariant.

The inline eval solver the runner dispatches cases to. An ISF finder needs a real session log and raises over inline plan text, which crashed the whole admission run mid-way; INLINE_UNADMISSIBLE_CRITERIA (co-located with the raise) is the single source the runner skips on (discovered live during the AC10 run).

Its _runnable previously reported an ISF criterion as runnable and would burn an epoch raising on both arms; closed in lockstep with the eval_solver ISF skip so the two agree on which criteria are inline-admissible.
